# Conformance vectors from OpenSSL 3.5.7, an implementation this
# package shares no code with. Each line is
#   level|encapsulation key hex|decapsulation key hex|ciphertext hex|shared secret hex
# The key pair is OpenSSL's, generated from the seed
# 01 02 ... 40, so it can be compared byte for byte. The
# ciphertext is OpenSSL's too, with the secret it carries, so
# decapsulation is checked against something this package did
# not produce.
#
# Regenerate only against another FIPS 203 implementation --
# never from this package, which would make the test assert only
# that it agrees with itself.
